name: Raven's Progressive Matrices
description: A classic non-verbal reasoning benchmark adapted for LLM evaluation. Tests visual and abstract reasoning patterns, sequence completion, and analogical reasoning without relying on language-specific knowledge.
reputation: Gold standard for measuring general cognitive ability and abstract reasoning in multimodal models
notes: Originally a psychological test; adapted for multimodal LLM evaluation. Tests reasoning independent of language training; useful for assessing fundamental cognitive capabilities.
